verdict.rationale: GitCafe is a Git forge, so CI/CD is a fair question for it. It has no native CI runner and no deployment feature. It does plug into external pipelines: Buildkite builds appear on a CI tab and as PR checks, signed webhooks fire on pushes and merged PRs to trigger an external server, and personal access tokens let CI jobs authenticate. Any actual deployment automation has to live in third-party tooling. Missing for 10: native CI/CD pipeline execution, deployment/environment features (deploy jobs, environments, approvals, secrets), documentation of a deployment workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.
